Answer: C
Reason: The chest radiograph demonstrates complete opacification of the left hemithorax with ipsilateral mediastinal shift and hyperinflation (radiolucency) of the right lung. In an asymptomatic young adult, this compensatory overinflation of the contralateral lung is a hallmark sign of pulmonary aplasia, distinguishing it from acquired causes of white-out like atelectasis or collapse where such massive compensatory hyperplasia/hyperinflation is less characteristic.
